sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Skibidi Snake.io is a classic snake game with a twist. The gameplay is simple yet challenging, requiring players to navigate a snake through a maze-like arena while avoiding obstacles and competing with other snakes. The game features two main modes: Skibidi and Survival. In Skibidi, players must collect as many Skibidi as possible within the time limit, while in Survival, the goal is to outlast other snakes in a timed arena.

The gameplay mechanics are straightforward: use your mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to move your snake through the arena, collect Skibidi, and avoid collisions with other snakes or the arena walls. As you eat Skibidi, your snake will grow in size, and the longer it gets, the more difficult it becomes to control. This adds an extra layer of challenge to the game, requiring players to adapt their strategy and timing to outmaneuver their opponents.

One of the standout features of Skibidi Snake.io is its responsive controls. The game responds seamlessly to input, allowing players to execute precise movements and sharp turns.
